clips.title: The story
paras: Boulderslide Cavern is a subterranean warren tucked at the deepest end of Boulderslide Ravine in the Stonetalon Mountains. It serves as the primary den and excavation site for the local Boulderslide kobolds, who obsessively tunnel in search of glowing mineral formations.

The Boulderslide kobolds have burrowed deep into the crags of Stonetalon, establishing Boulderslide Cavern as their stronghold. Unlike ordinary vermin merely seeking shelter, these kobolds mine frantically for resonite, a rare glowing purple crystal embedded throughout the stone. The crystals pulse with lingering earthen magic, driving the creatures into a defensive frenzy against any intruders who approach their dig.
